subject: RC26-0375 – thank you and three remaining points
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear National Monuments Record team,

Thank you for the consolidated reply of 29 September / 6 October 2026 (RC26-0375) and for confirming that the requests of 8, 15, 17 and 20 September are now treated as fully answered.

Three points remain:

1. Please supply the free scans of NMR 6048945, 6048943 and 6048941 as indicated.
2. Confirm whether any accession data, transfer note or provenance record exists for the material held under NPRN 20182 (beyond the statement that none is held in registered files).
3. Confirm whether the emergency-recording case previously catalogued under the wrong place-name (Bonvilston) has now been correctly linked.

Yours faithfully,

Requester
